name: init_workspace
description: Initializes the .docsgrep workspace in the specified project directory to store cached data, logs, and reports. Also automatically updates .gitignore.

projectPath.description: The absolute path to the local project root.

name: detect_stack
description: Detects the project's technology stack by reading package manager files (e.g., package.json, composer.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml).

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to analyze.

excludePath.description: Optional. Glob patterns to exclude from scanning.

name: check_style
description: Analyzes project coding style: linter configs, conventions, and implicit patterns inferred from codebase samples.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to analyze.

excludePath.description: Optional. Glob patterns to exclude from scanning.

name: find_docs
description: Discovers documentation files (README, docs/**/*.md) in a local directory.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to explore.

includePath.description: Optional. Glob patterns to include in scanning.

excludePath.description: Optional. Glob patterns to exclude from scanning.

name: clone_repo
description: Clones a remote git repository into the workspace cache and discovers documentation files. Supports authentication for private repos.

repoUrl.description: The URL of the git repository (e.g., https://github.com/user/repo.git).

tag.description: Optional. Specific tag or version to explore. Overrides branch.

authToken.description: Optional. Authentication token for private repositories.

sshKeyPath.description: Optional. Path to SSH private key.

localProjectPath.description: Optional. Local project path for workspace.

name: read_file
description: Reads the contents of a specific documentation or source file.

filePath.description: The absolute path to the file to read.

name: clear_cache
description: Removes cached repositories from the .docsgrep workspace that exceed the specified age threshold (default: 7 days).

localProjectPath.description: The absolute path to the local project containing .docsgrep workspace.

maxAgeDays.description: Maximum age in days for cached repos (default: 7).

name: search_docs
description: Greps for a pattern within documentation files (README, docs/**/*.md) in a local directory. Returns matching lines with file path and line number. Results ranked by relevance.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to search.

pattern.description: The regex pattern to search for.

filePattern.description: Optional. Regex to filter which doc files to search.

contextLines.description: Optional. Number of surrounding context lines (max 5).

name: analyze_code
description: Performs an enterprise-grade code quality audit (linting). Analyzes tech stack, conventions, and applies industry best practices.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to audit.

filePatterns.description: Optional. Glob patterns for files to audit.

name: lint_interactive
description: Generates an interactive audit prompt showing detected tech stack and available linting options.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory.

name: audit_security
description: Performs a comprehensive security audit covering OWASP Top 10, secrets detection, privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA), and dependency vulnerabilities.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to audit.

filePatterns.description: Optional. Glob patterns for files to scan.

name: security_interactive
description: Generates an interactive security audit prompt showing scan coverage (OWASP, secrets, privacy, dependencies) and options.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory.

name: catch_bugs
description: Detects bugs and potential issues in code: race conditions, memory leaks, runtime errors, dependency coupling, and performance problems.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to analyze.

filePatterns.description: Optional. Glob patterns for files to scan.

name: semantic_search
description: Searches documentation based on meaning (semantic search), not just keyword matching. Understands natural language queries and finds relevant docs.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to search.

query.description: Natural language query about what you're looking for.

topK.description: Optional. Number of top results to return (default: 5).

name: summarize_doc
description: Summarizes a documentation file by extracting headings and key content into a concise overview.

filePath.description: The absolute path to the documentation file to summarize.

maxLength.description: Optional. Maximum summary length in characters (default: 500).

name: find_related
description: Finds documentation related to a specific topic using keyword similarity matching.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to search.

topic.description: Topic or concept to find related docs for.

name: check_stale
description: Detects stale documentation that has not been updated within the specified age threshold.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local directory to check.

compareWithCode.description: Optional. Also check if docs match current code (default: true).

name: sync_documentation
description: Automatically creates or updates documentation based on code changes. Detects new methods, changed signatures, and generates doc stubs.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local project.

filePaths.description: Optional. Specific files that changed (default: auto-detect from git).

name: verify_docs
description: Checks consistency between code and documentation. Verifies that all documented methods actually exist and that parameters match reality.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local project.

docPath.description: The path to the documentation file to validate.

strictMode.description: Optional. Fail on warnings too (default: false).

name: get_context
description: Provides relevant documentation context based on the file you are currently working on, using import analysis and directory proximity.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local project.

currentFilePath.description: The path to the file currently being worked on.

name: check_delta
description: Compares documented symbols against actual code implementations to identify documentation drift.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local project.

docPath.description: The path to the documentation file.

includeCodeSnippets.description: Optional. Include actual code in diff (default: true).

name: show_help
description: Provides comprehensive help for all docsgrep tools with detailed examples, common patterns, and pro tips.

toolName.description: Optional. Specific tool to get help for (default: all tools).

name: check_artefacts
description: Identifies documentation that may be outdated based on recent code changes. Uses git history to prioritize updates.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the local project.

sinceCommit.description: Optional. Check changes since this commit (default: last commit).

name: measure_coverage
description: Measures documentation coverage (docblocks) across the codebase. Language-agnostic support for JS, TS, PHP, Python, Go, Rust, etc.

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the source directory.

filePatterns.description: Optional. Glob patterns to filter source files.

publicOnly.description: Optional. Only count public APIs (default: true).

name: detect_patterns
description: Maps project architectural patterns (MVC, Repository, etc.) and suggests refactoring candidates (Base Class, Trait, Interface).

dirPath.description: The absolute path to the project directory.

minSimilarity.description: Minimum similarity score (0-1) to suggest abstraction. Default: 0.8
